name: GetSuppItemCat
caption: Get supplier item category

configuration.description: Supplier code as set up on the Supplier Codes page (table 5564016), e.g. ACME. SmartText. Trimmed and upper-cased; empty, longer than 20 or not set up fails the step at runtime.

The supplier's category of the item: its code (Code[50], compared upper-cased) or, if no code matches, its name (Text[100], exact text). SmartText, trimmed. Empty or not found = the supplier code's defaults.

outputs.name: ItemTemplateCode
outputs.when: always - may be empty when neither the tree nor the supplier code's default has one

outputs.name: ItemCategoryCode
outputs.when: always - may be empty when neither the tree nor the supplier code's default has one

outputs.name: ItemTemplate
outputs.when: only when ItemTemplateCode is not empty and the Item Templ. exists

outputs.name: ItemCategory
outputs.when: only when ItemCategoryCode is not empty and the Item Category exists

outputs.name: CategoryFound
outputs.when: always - 'true' when the supplier's category was found, 'false' when it was empty or not found

rules.check: The configuration dialog refuses to save while Supplier Code is empty.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: supplierCode resolves to empty text, to more than 20 characters, or to a code that is not in table 5564016.
rules.message: The supplier code %1 is not set up. Add it on the Supplier Codes page.

rules.check: category is not empty but matches neither a code nor a name of the supplier code's categories. Logged as Info; the defaults are returned and the flow continues.
rules.message: Supplier category %1 of %2 was not found - the supplier code's defaults are used.

notes: Requires the AutoFlow Supplier Foundation app. See docs/apps/SupplierFoundation.md.
Offered in the step picker for every trigger.
Read-only: the step reads tables 5564016 and 5564017 and writes nothing.

Each of the two values is taken from the nearest category up the tree that has one; what is still missing comes from the supplier code's Default Item Template Code / Default Item Category Code. The walk stops at a missing parent or a cycle.

ItemTemplateCode is an Item Templ. (table 1382), not a RapidStart Configuration Template: it cannot be passed to Insert Record's templateCode. Copy the fields you need from {{<slug>_ItemTemplate.<field>}}.
